newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - April 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - April 3.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy. FRATERNITE MATIN - Ivory Coast wants to become a major producer and exporter of oil and gas by 2005 -- the Rotterdam and Singapore of Africa -- said Energy Minister Lamine Fadika during visit by Prime Minister Daniel Kablan Duncan to Ivorian Refining Company. - Ivory Coast wants to boost its oil refining capacity to an annual 10 million tonnes by 2005 from a current 3.3 million tonnes, Energy Minister Lamine Fadika says. - Electrification of rural Ivory Coast reaches a record 320 communes in the past one year. - Current university year could be written off if disturbances continue on Ivorian campuses. LA VOIE - Ivorian housing and environment ministry calls international tenders for garbage collection in the commercial capital Abidjan. Details obtainable from the ministry on fax: +225 21 04 95 tel 21 21 91. LE JOUR - Ivorian tax workers to go ahead with 48-hour strike over conditions from today despite anonymous threat letters to union leaders. -- Abidjan newsroom +225 21 90 90
